title: PM-Eng 1:1 prep - API/Console/Dedicated/Private
content:
PM <> Eng lead 1:1 prep (informal)
Owners: Jamie Lee (PM), Ethan Ramirez (Eng Lead)
Date: 2026-03-04 (weekly)
Context: quick sync to align on short-term priorities across API, Console, Dedicated and Private deployments. Focus on unblockers, rollout plan for model pinning in Console, Dedicated capacity oversubscription incident follow-up, and KMS onboarding for Private.

Agenda (15-20 min)
- Quick status (2 min): what shipped / blocked this week
- Dedicated incident recap + mitigation (5 min)
- Console: model pinning rollout + telemetry gaps (5 min)
- Private: KMS / certs timeline + E2E smoke tests (3 min)
- AOB / decisions / next steps (2-5 min)

Notes / talking points
1) Quick status
- API: token-based rate limiting change deployed to staging; some non-prod regression on streaming reconnects (INF-421). Need eng triage.
- Console: canary for model pinning feature 10% traffic; telemetry shows missing per-route token-cost for pinned models. UX team flagged confusing billing numbers.
- Dedicated: Friday oversubscription spike OOS for a small subset (cust A). Root cause preliminary: autoscaler mis-evaluated GPU headroom when nodes running mixed quantized models.
- Private: early EE request for KMS/HSM integration + offline install checklist. Legal asked for audit log sample.

2) Dedicated incident follow-up (goal: avoid repeat, clear owner + timeline)
- Immediate: push a hotfix to autoscaler decision logic to treat quantized backends as separate capacity pools. (Owner: Ethan)
- Short-term: add e2e test that simulates mixed-quantized workloads + scale-up scenario (Owner: SRE / Ethan; due: 2026-03-10)
- Postmortem: I (Jamie) will draft a short incident postmortem; include customer impact, mitigation timeline, and recommended rollout gating. (Due: 2026-03-06)
- Metrics to add: per-node model-variant counts, autoscaler decision debug logs (Ethan to add instrumentation ticket INF-428).

3) Console model pinning rollout
- Current: 10% canary; feedback: billing/usage breakdown not showing pinned vs fallback model usage. This causes confusion for customers about cost.
- Ask: can backend emit a pinned_model_id tag on token-level billing traces? Would let Console show exact cost per model. (Ethan: feasibility + perf cost estimate)
- UX ask: small banner in Console explaining canary + how pinning works. (PM/Design)
- Decision needed: hold canary until tag emitted OR continue and surface a warning. Prefer to hold if tagging is >1d effort.

4) Private deployment: KMS + onboarding checklist
- Sales/customer ask: HSM-backed keys + audit proof for one pilot customer (regulated). Need timeline + checklist.
- Action: create a minimal E2E smoke test that validates: key rotation, encrypt/decrypt at rest, audit log export. (Owner: Priya; due: 2026-03-12)
- Blocker: legal wants sample audit log format — Jamie to pull an example from previous Private installs and share in Slack.

Open blockers / decisions
- Streaming reconnect regression in staging (INF-421): affects hosted API streaming; severity: medium. Need eng triage; possible revert of last patch if not actionable by tomorrow. (Ethan)
- Model-tagging for billing traces: if >2d effort, hold canary. (Decision: ASAP)
- Dedicated autoscaler fix rollout window: can we schedule hotfix during low-traffic window this weekend? Need SRE alignment.

Action items (clear owners + dates)
- Ethan: triage streaming reconnect regression (INF-421) and either fix or revert by 2026-03-05.
- Ethan: implement autoscaler hotfix + add per-node model-variant metric. Hotfix deploy target: 2026-03-06; metrics by 2026-03-10.
- Jamie: draft incident postmortem and customer communication; 1st draft by 2026-03-06. Linked: INF-421, INF-428.
- Priya: create Private KMS E2E smoke test plan + initial checklist; due 2026-03-12.
- Jamie + Design: write Console canary banner copy and determine UX fallback messaging if tagging delayed; deliver mock by 2026-03-08.
- Jamie: pull sample audit log and post to #security-privacy for legal review by 2026-03-05.

Backlog / follow-ups (not immediate)
- Batching experiments for short prompt flows: revisit next sprint (ticket: PERF-77).
- Quantization recommendation docs for Dedicated customers (how to choose q4 vs q8) — put on product backlog.
- Rollout playbook for Private: include KMS, cert rotation, onboarding runbook. (Longer term).

Meeting prep checklist (for me)
- Bring up canary status + telemetry gap (ask Ethan for quick feasibility check)
- Confirm hotfix deploy window with SRE (quick sync after this 1:1)
- Align on who communicates to the pilot customer and timing (Jamie to handle notice)

Notes to self
- Keep postmortem concise (3 bullets: timeline, impact, next steps).
- If tagging for billing is cheap, prioritize it; good long-term telemetry win.
- Check whether INF-421 has any related PRs (PR #312 might be related).

Next 1:1 agenda items (for next week)
- Postmortem review + customer comm status
- Autoscaler metrics: early telemetry review
- Console canary: decision to widen or rollback

End of notes.

Quick links (for convo)
- Staging error logs: https://sentry.redwood/c/staging/streams
- Canaries dashboard: https://console.redwood/canaries
- Incident ticket: INF-421
- Autoscaler metrics ticket: INF-428
summary: 1:1 prep notes + action items focused on Dedicated autoscaler incident, Console model pinning telemetry, Private KMS onboarding, and streaming regression. Clear owners and near-term dates set.
